verdict.rationale: Thoropass documents automatic collection from connected systems through auditor-vetted native integrations, where "high-quality data automatically satisfies evidence requests" (docs-21, docs-35, docs-67). Monitors check connected systems such as AWS, Azure and GCP, and integrations refresh data "up to daily or ad-hoc," which covers the schedule element (docs-54, docs-74). Access reviews also automate evidence gathering (docs-30). missing for 10: explicit documentation that collected artifacts are timestamped, a concrete statement that machine-gathered evidence replaces manual screenshots and CSV uploads, detail on per-integration collection frequency, and independent or hands-on corroboration beyond vendor claims.
